decisions.statement: The loop goes round only when the supervisor killed the child and no shutdown is under way.
An exit the supervisor did not ask for is named a user's only where the child exited cleanly.
A null child from adoption ends the loop.
Nothing is spawned in the place of a null child.
exit-after-iterations counts the iterations already begun.
The loop runs exactly the count exit-after-iterations states.
The agent id and session id and resume and prompt are loop variables rewritten each round.
A null pending event at exit breaks the loop.
The idle probe reads the Claude pid through a closure that is empty on the first pass.
Every exit path runs the same finalize step over the last child and the proxy.
Nothing here spawns a child or wires its streams or reads a word of its output.

definition: a seat's run as a repeated loop of Claude children, one iteration at a time
